rows.grounds: salutatory mantra formula; namo governs dative nārāyaṇāya; hasakahalahrīṃ and sakalahrīṃ are mantra epithets/bīja-elements kept byte-exact within the fused token

items.question: To which mantra-form of Nārāyaṇa is this obeisance directed?
premises: The formula begins with namo, expressing reverential obeisance.
The dative nārāyaṇāya names Nārāyaṇa as the recipient of obeisance.
The elements hasakahalahrīṃ and sakalahrīṃ qualify this form with specific mantra syllables.
items.inference: The verse offers obeisance to Nārāyaṇa in a specific mantra-form marked by the syllables hasakahalahrīṃ and sakalahrīṃ.
uncertainties: The precise ritual or semantic function of the components hasaka and hala within the mantra is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, in the mantra-form hasaka-hala-hrīṃ and sakala-hrīṃ.
